h0.content: On-shift work cycle — worker perspective (ADR-0026 diagram 2 of 5, drawn 1st)

n1.content: worker_authenticate: QR onboarding / WebAuthn passkey / OTP (not corporate email+password)

n2.content: load_own_org_path_subtree: cache ONLY worker's own org_path branch, not whole tenant (data-minimization)

n4.content: fetch_task_queue: MCP tools/call, tenant_id + org_path scoped, allowed_tools per harness_specs.agent_name

n5.content: load_task_queue: from local IndexedDB/OPFS cache (last synced) — data may be stale

n6.content: worker selects/opens a task from queue

n7.content: render_current_step: State-Machine Step Runner shows ONLY current DRAKON IR node, not full canvas

n9.content: worker selects branch (DRAKON question one/two) -> advance current_step_id

n10.content: worker performs physical action / captures evidence (photo, scan, sensor reading)

n11.content: materials, tools, or guidance needed from supervisor?

n12.content: worker -> AI supervisor: ordinary MCP tools/call against supervisor's harness_specs.allowed_tools (Slice 3.4a/4.4 pattern, not a new agent-hydration mechanism)

n14.content: anomaly / unexpected situation encountered during this task?

n15.content: worker opens Micro-ADR (3 fields: context / action / result + evidence) -> local queue, status PENDING_REVIEW

n16.content: worker finalizes task result + any KB note into local encrypted queue, status PENDING_REVIEW (no auto-promotion, no confidence-score merge)

n18.content: sync: workforce.synclogs + workforce.submitmicroadr (MCP) -> D1 tenant_work_items / tenant_micro_adrs; LLM-as-a-Verifier K=4 runs advisory-only, does not auto-promote

n19.content: stay in local offline queue, retry on browser 'online' event — event-driven polling, not a persistent WebSocket (battery)

n20.content: more tasks left in shift queue?

n21.content: worker reports shift-end status (aggregate summary of tasks/notes this shift)

end.content: Shift ends. PENDING_REVIEW items now wait in Supervisor Review Queue (separate diagram: KB authoring/promotion, ADR-0026 item 3 — not detailed here).

meta.description: Diagram 2 of ADR-0026's 4-diagram detailing list ('on-shift work cycle'). Drawn FIRST, ahead of onboarding (listed 1st in the ADR text), because it resolves two open questions at once (Q2 KB write-back boundary, Q3 supervisor-as-harness-spec-role) and its branches are exactly where all four round-2 risks below actually surface — onboarding is a one-time linear setup and doesn't exercise them.

confirmed_against_code.harness_specs_allowed_tools_pattern: cloudflare-worker/worker-mcp-drakon.js:resolveMcpTenantAndSpec, packages/harness-contract/src/index.ts:validateHarnessSpec — verified live via GitNexus, not hypothetical

offline_sync_conflict.note: No merge policy decided yet (CRDT vs lease/checkout) for two workers touching the same task/resource while both offline. This diagram shows WHERE the conflict window opens (n16 local write, n19 deferred sync) — does not resolve it.

device_loss_theft.note: n1/n2 already reflect the agreed mitigation (passkey/OTP auth, org_path-subtree-only caching). n16's 'local encrypted queue' still needs a remote-revocation/poison-pill mechanism, not yet designed.

multilingual_runtime.note: Supervisor MCP call at n12 is the point where per-node DRAKON IR localization and AI-generated-content translation middleware would need to sit. Not designed here.

native_hardware_battery.note: n10 (camera/scan/sensor) and n19 (event-driven polling instead of persistent WS) reflect the current PWA-first recommendation; a thin native wrapper (Capacitor/Tauri) remains a likely later addition, not decided here.

not_covered_by_this_diagram: Worker onboarding/bootstrap (ADR-0026 item 1 — separate diagram, next)
KB authoring/promotion review flow on the supervisor side beyond the single n18 sync call (ADR-0026 item 3)
Q6 tenant hierarchy (who can see/act on whose data) — orthogonal data-model question, separate diagram, needed before any Slice 5.1 architect pass
